summary.title: Maturity Model (BSIMM)
summary.one_liner: BSIMM is a descriptive benchmark that measures your software security (AppSec) program against observed practices from 100+ organizations, helping you build a Maturity Action Plan.
takeaways: BSIMM is descriptive: it documents the security practices an organization actually performs rather than prescribing them.
A BSIMM assessment compares your AppSec program against data from hundreds of assessments across 100+ organizations.
Assessment results can be used to find strengths and gaps and to prioritize security work.
The assessment output feeds a customized Maturity Action Plan (MAP) tied to your risks, resources and objectives.
The page is mainly a vendor services pitch from Black Duck; it names no specific activities or methodology details beyond the summary.
summary.summary: This page promotes BSIMM, a software security maturity benchmark offered as assessment services by Black Duck. It states that BSIMM is built on observed practices from hundreds of assessments across more than 100 organizations, and that it is descriptive, documenting an organization's actual practices. Results are meant to show how a program compares to peers, reveal gaps, and support a tailored Maturity Action Plan. The page is mostly marketing, and the listed counts for activities, industries and organizations are not filled in on the page text, so no specific figures are given here.
